{% translate "Monitoring Rules" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} The overview "Monitoring Rules" shows all the defined security rules and offline rules that are monitored. Security rules are marked with the icon gpp_maybe and offline rules are marked with the icon desktop_access_disabled. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} You can define new security rules from the overview by clicking on "Add new security rule" above the list of defined rules. You can edit an existing security rule by selecting it in the list. The interface for both operations has the same form. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} Similarly, you can define a new offline rule by clicking on "Add new offline rule" above the list of defined rules. You can edit an existing offline rule by selecting it in the list. The interface for both operations has the same form. {% endblocktranslate %}
